job.text: Look up the average donation in each region

source.shows: a request for fractions of averages: the meaningful-total check fails, since three regions' averages add up to nothing anyone would quote, so a bar chart (R7-02, G0.12)
the book's pie of averages, asked for: refused by the first check (R7-02, G0.12 [L])
the book's stacked bar of averages, reaching a meaningless $58: refused by the same check

the same request without the parts' facts: whether the values add up, whether every part is shown and whether a part contains another cannot be read from the numbers, so all three are asked for before any pie (D-1; overlap by the owner's decision of 1 Oct 2026)
